name: cuebar
title: Cuebar
description: Send commands to Cuebar, the command palette for Apple Music.
author: tomatosoup83

commands.name: run-command
commands.title: Run Cuebar Command
commands.subtitle: Cuebar
commands.description: Type a Cuebar command — pause, next, shuffle off — or a song, album or playlist name.

arguments.name: command
arguments.placeholder: pause, next, take on me, album swag ii

commands.name: next
commands.title: Next Track
commands.subtitle: Cuebar
commands.description: Skip to the next track through Cuebar.

commands.name: previous
commands.title: Previous Track
commands.subtitle: Cuebar
commands.description: Go back to the previous track through Cuebar.

commands.name: toggle-shuffle
commands.title: Toggle Shuffle
commands.subtitle: Cuebar
commands.description: Turn Apple Music shuffle on or off through Cuebar.
